question.prompt: If \(200 \le a \le 400\) and \(600 \le b \le 1200,\) then the largest value of the quotient \(\dfrac{b}{a}\) is

solutions.explanation:
Both quantities are positive, and \(a\ge200\), so the quotient is always defined. A positive fraction increases when its numerator increases or its denominator decreases. Therefore every allowed choice satisfies
\[
\frac ba\le\frac{1200}{a}\le\frac{1200}{200}=6.
\]
The values \(b=1200\) and \(a=200\) are both allowed, and they give equality. Hence the largest quotient is \(6\), choice \(\mathrm{C}\).
solutions.title: Use the largest numerator and smallest denominator
